mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an overall schematic representative of a lesson which covers a period of time which may be weekly or monthly."
A lesson plan is an overall schematic representative of a lesson which covers a period of time which may be weekly or monthly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which enables pupils to find things out for themselves with minimal prompting by the teacher."
Exploratory technique is that which enables pupils to find things out for themselves with minimal prompting by the teacher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means talking over concepts from various points of view, with the teacher acting as the moderator."
Discussion Method This method simply means talking over concepts from various points of view, with the teacher acting as the moderator.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an experimental subject, which involves the use of materials, equipment and apparatus."
Science is an experimental subject, which involves the use of materials, equipment and apparatus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of inquiry method of teaching used in multi-grade teaching."
The project method is a type of inquiry method of teaching used in multi-grade teaching.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most effective way to maximize pupils' success."
Heterogeneous (mixed-ability) grouping is the most effective way to maximize pupils' success.
